# Eden Rise Dental

> A family-friendly dental clinic in Berwick, Victoria offering comprehensive general, cosmetic, and specialist dental care including implants, orthodontics, and sleep apnoea solutions.

Eden Rise Dental is a local Berwick-based practice led by Dr Olga Selemba, providing affordable, patient-centered dental services for families and children. The clinic specializes in general dentistry, cosmetic treatments, dental implants, orthodontics, and innovative sleep apnoea solutions.

## Key Topics

- General Dentistry
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Dental Implants

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services): Main services overview: general, cosmetic, implants, orthodontics, sleep apnoea
- [General Dentistry](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/general-dentistry): General dentistry services: check-ups, extractions, root canal, fillings, x-rays
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic services: teeth whitening, implants, veneers, dentures, smile makeovers
- [Dental Implants](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/dental-implants): Dental implants and tooth replacement solutions for missing teeth
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy: painless treatment for tooth decay and endodontic care

## Specialty Treatments

- [Braces & Orthodontics](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/braces-and-orthodontics): Orthodontic treatments: braces, clear aligners, teeth alignment, ClearCorrect
- [Children's Dentistry](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/childrens-dentistry): Children's dentistry: dental care for kids, braces, nervous children support
- [Sleep Apnoea Solutions](https://www.edenrisedental.com.au/services/snoring-sleep-apnoea-dental-solutions): Sleep apnoea solutions: oral appliances, CPAP alternative, 3DS Advance
